intro.fallback: They run into their friends including Sasuke, which surprises both Sakura and Naruto, but with different personalities, and to add to the confusion, no one knows who Tobi is.
They realise they are in another world where Sakura's father was the Fourth Hokage, who saved the village instead of Minato, and in this world Naruto is named Menma instead.
As Naruto and Sakura return home, Sakura is happy for the new freedom she has, while Naruto hurries home to his apartment hoping to see his parents, only to find he does not live there.

outro.fallback: While Sakura is still enjoying her life, she wonders how Naruto is doing.
While Naruto attempts to ignore his parents, he sees an album showing him how his life would have been if his parents had been alive.
